## v0.5.2 · Atomic Disable and Independent Releases

v0.5.2 fixes the v0.5 Starter lifecycle regression reported in [#185](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/issues/185) and completes the one-time transition to independently versioned Source, Strategy, and Provider packages.

### Fix

- The existing `id: mnemon` profile Entry is again the atomic switch for the complete Starter. Setting `disabled: true` now disables the Core/Host, all three bundled Sources, the default Strategy, and all three optional Strategy enhancements together.
- DSH no longer fails startup with four Entries pending on `mnemonMemory` when a profile retained the disabled state from v0.4. Existing Entry ids and configuration targets remain compatible, and disabling the Starter does not uninstall packages or delete memory data.

### Package release model

- This release publishes the Starter and all sixteen official plugins once at `0.5.2` because the independent-version transition changes each package's published dependency metadata.
- Future releases select only packages whose own artifacts changed, plus `dsh-mnemon` whenever its exact tested composition changes. Selected plugin dependency layers publish with bounded concurrency, and the Starter publishes last.

### Verification and delivery

- [PR #186](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/186) reproduces the exact disabled-profile failure on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 and Node.js 22.23.2, then verifies real Headless and WebUI startup with all eight Mnemon Entries disabled and no `mnemon_*` tool leakage.
- [PR #181](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/181) adds Changesets-backed release intent, changed-package validation, frozen selected artifacts, dependency-layer publication, and Registry read-back checks.

### Install or upgrade

`v0.5.2` is published on the npm `latest` channel:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.2
```

Use `headless` instead of `web` for a Headless profile, then restart DSH. No storage migration is required. Back up the effective memory root, Documents, DSH profile/configuration, and separately managed Provider data before upgrading.

Full compatibility and rollback details are in the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.2/docs/en/releases/v0.5.2.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.2/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.2.md).
